attributes.residual: PARK STANDS, now with a fully named mechanism and decisive negative evidence. State: target/ours 272/271 instructions, real 45, fuzzy 99.22794%, opcode multiset 3t, and exactly ONE --ops cluster: `replace T[194:196]@308-310=['bne','b'] O[194:195]@308-30c=['beq']`. Target at 0x308 is `bl fn_80054CDC; cmpwi r3,0; bne ->0x310; b ->0x1a0` where 0x310 is the instruction after the `b` (empty block) and 0x1a0 is the loop top, i.e. the unconditional branch is a BACKEDGE. MWCC compiles our `if (fn_80054CDC() != 0) { goto frame_done; } goto frame_top;` to the single fused `beq ->0x1a0`. DECISIVE NEW EVIDENCE, a whole-image scan of build/GUNE5D/asm (script banked at build/scratch/emptyblock.py, and worth re-deriving rather than trusting this prose): 563 instances of the empty-block conditional-over-unconditional pair exist across the target image, and 65 of them share this function's exact micro-shape (a plain `cmpwi rX, 0x0` immediately before a beq/bne). Of those 65, exactly ONE has the BACKEDGE variant - ControllerMessageBox itself, at 0x8006DAF4 (= function base 0x8006D7EC + 0x308). Every other instance is the forward variant, whose `b` targets an epilogue or a loop-increment block; those ARE reproducible and several sit in byte-exact functions whose C we hold, e.g. dolphin/os/OSRtc.c::ReadSram (`if (!EXILock(0, 1, NULL)) { return 0; }`) and game/anim/atree.c::AtreeFindNodeIdx (`for (...) { if (strncmp(...) == 0) { return i; } }`). This is precisely the stop signal the governing law names: a shape search that returns only your own non-exact function means no positive control exists anywhere in the image to read the spelling off. The forward/backedge split is the newly identified boundary and is proposed as its own law record alongside this one. Classification: SCHEDULE / front-end basic-block layout, not REGISTER_ONLY and not source-reachable. Do not spend further probes on branch spelling at this site; the function's only other divergence is the accumulator/temporary register-color cascade already capped in v1.
